user.title: Connect Axios Famiglia
user.description: Add one entry per student. The student name is used as a prefix for the device and entities (for example sensor.axios_mario_absences). If the account has several students, you will choose which one this entry shows in the next step.

student.title: Choose the student
student.description: This account has several students. Choose the one this entry will show. To add the others, repeat the procedure with the same login and a different student name.

error.name_in_use: A student with this name is already configured. Choose a different name.
error.student_not_found: The selected student was not found on the portal. Try again.
error.student_not_selected: The portal did not confirm the change of student. Check the Home Assistant logs and report an issue.
error.rvt_not_found: Login succeeded but a required security token could not be found. Check the Home Assistant logs for details and report an issue.
error.init_sequence_failed: Login succeeded but a required initialization step failed. Check the Home Assistant logs for details (search for 'dashboard init call') and report an issue.

abort.all_students_configured: All the students of this account are already configured

init.title: Axios Famiglia options
init.description: These settings can be changed at any time. The integration reloads when you save.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the portal is queried. Minimum 5 minutes, to avoid overloading the portal.
data_description.register_days: How many recent days of the class register are used for homework, tests, annotations, notes and lesson topics (1 to 90).
data_description.communications_limit: How many of the latest communications appear in the sensor list, the calendar and the news event (1 to 50).
data_description.request_timeout: Maximum wait for each request to the portal (10 to 120 seconds).
